title: SkyW4lker Phishing Kit: Microsoft 365 Threat to US Firms
description: SkyW4lker is a phishing kit active since June 2026 that targets Microsoft 365 authentication by exploiting OAuth 2.0 device-code flows to bypass MFA. It uses password-protected email attachments leading victims through CAPTCHA pages to malicious sites requesting device codes. The kit primarily targets US firms, especially in technology, manufacturing, and government sectors, and shares infrastructure with the Gabagool phishing kit.
